newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: VNU says open to offers on Blenheim.
newsitem.headline: VNU says open to offers on Blenheim.

text.p: Dutch publisher VNU said on Tuesday it had decided in principle to sell its 15 percent stake in exhibition organisor Blenheim following United News & Media's announcement it had secured 51 percent of the company.
Schikker said VNU was aware when it acquired its 15 percent stake that a rival bid could be made for the company.
"It was always possible that a third party would bid for all of Blenheim," he said.
Earlier on Tuesday, United News & Media Plc said it had made a five stg a share agreed offer for the Blenheim Group, valuing the company 592.5 million stg.

United and Anglo-Dutch group Reed-Elsevier had long been seen as rivals for Blenheim but VNU entered the fray last week with a share raid, accumulating a 15 percent stake at five stg a share. --Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5000
